crowdhuman.name: CrowdHuman
crowdhuman.source_note: Official source https://www.crowdhuman.org/download.html links (annotation_val.odgt, CrowdHuman_val.zip on Google Drive) returned HTTP 404 when checked live -- using the Mendeley YOLO-format mirror of the same dataset instead: https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/tttr2h6pz4/1

pets2009.name: PETS2009
pets2009.status: PARTIAL: ROI + ground-truth count metadata downloaded for 3/3 regions, but this archive contains only pre-extracted features/segmentation masks, NOT raw RGB video frames -- a VisionGuard zone_densities() vs. PETS2009-region comparison requires the original multi-camera video sequences, which are hosted separately and were not reliably retrievable in this session. Reporting dataset metadata only.

le2i.name: Le2i
le2i.latency_caveat: frames-from-clip-start-to-confirmation, NOT true fall-onset latency (this re-packaged dataset has no pre-fall baseline frames) -- see UR Fall for true onset-to-confirmation latency

caucafall.name: CAUCAFall
caucafall.status: PARTIAL: Mendeley's file-listing API has no working pagination (see module docstring) -- only ~50 frames of ONE activity from ONE subject were reachable, with no activity-name metadata, so fall-vs-ADL event-level accuracy could NOT be computed. Reporting person-detection accuracy on the frames that were reachable instead. Manual full access: https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/7w7fccy7ky/4 -> 'Download All Files'.

uhctd.name: UHCTD
uhctd.status: SKIPPED: requires a signed Dataset Agreement (not an anonymous/instant download) -- verified live by visiting the project page. Manual steps: open https://pmantini.github.io/profile/projects/uhctd/, follow the 'Dataset Agreement' link, and once granted access use the devkit at https://github.com/QuantitativeImagingLaboratory/ctd-devkit to prepare the data. The synthetic covered/frozen tamper test (see 'Synthetic Tamper Test' in this report) runs regardless and exercises the same TamperDetector classes/thresholds.

lines: Minimum frame rate for reliable CROWD detection: ~15 fps (F1 stays >= 90% of the best observed F1=0.39)
Minimum frame rate for reliable FALL confirmation: ~20 fps (Recall stays >= 90% of the best observed Recall=0.67)
Minimum resolution: 240p (320x240) -- derived from Mall Dataset (count-accuracy proxy = 1 - MAE/mean_count), metric stays >= 90% of its best observed value (0.23)
Note: on MOT20-01 (extremely dense crowd scene), detection recall barely varies across resolutions (0.09-0.10) -- in that scene, crowd DENSITY/occlusion is the bottleneck, not camera resolution.
Minimum person height in frame: >15% of frame height (~1583 instances sampled at this size; Recall >= 90% of best observed Recall=0.47)
